method: Independent-axis universality review. This pack has no coverage profiles: the planner pairs axis index k of episode_objects, time_place_scopes, mechanisms and evidence_lenses with every subject, so each material axis list must be coherent with all fifty subjects, not merely with some. Each verdict below asks one question: does every value in this axis remain a sensible reading for this subject? The axes are deliberately subject-independent - episode_objects names WHO is asking, time_place_scopes names WHAT CONSTRAINS them, and mechanisms names a bounded action the asker can take - so no value assumes a domain, a period, a place, or a profession. Verdicts were taken per subject-axis pair against the exact bound document above.

axis_semantics.episode_objects: audience context: who is asking the question
axis_semantics.time_place_scopes: constraint: what bounds the asker, not a time or a place in this pack
axis_semantics.mechanisms: actionability: the bounded, non-professional-advice next step available to the asker
